items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: José de Jesus Tizol. Then he became a Senator

ctx.x: José de Jesus Tizol. Then he became a Senator, and when he used to talk about politics and so forth in Washington, they bring him from Puerto Rico, and he was the lawyer for the Commission from Puerto Rico.

So your Uncle Manuel got you in to the Municipal Orchestra and the musical band and the symphony orchestra, and you played for the ballet and the opera, and you were studying with him, all of this time, right?
